flash_697410.description: Two oil tankers caught fire in the eastern Strait of Hormuz after striking a naval mine, the Iranian Navy said Saturday.

flash_697409.description: The American Heritage capsized in the Mississippi River after a tanker struck it at the dock; none missing or critical.

flash_697407.description: Two political upheavals in one week elbowed Israel to the cusp of not being reckoned among the nations. Opinion.

flash_697405.description: MK Yitzhak Pindrus of United Torah Judaism says he believes Shas would join an agreement on military conscription, Shas quickly rejects remarks.

flash_697403.description: The Muslim Brotherhood’s long strategy is a threat to American Jews. Read the story of an insidious plan.

flash_697401.description: Jerusalem District Court orders Karim Khan, former prosecutor of the International Criminal Court in The Hague, to pay compensation to Eitan Mor and the families of Avinatan Or and Omri Miran.

flash_697399.description: Iran nuclear expert Avner Vilan flags another Isfahan enrichment site reported before Operation "Rising Lion". IAEA inspectors had no time to check it; any enriched material there remains unconfirmed. He warns against aerial-only monitoring.

flash_697397.description: Warning of 'pre-Holocaust vibe' on social media, E Street Band guitarist Steven Van Zandt is using songs by KISS and Leonard Cohen to teach students about Jewish heritage and the Holocaust.

flash_697395.description: Somerville’s City Council votes 10-1 to bar contracts with companies it deems complicit in humanitarian law violations, opponents say the ordinance singles out 'Israel and Palestine.'

flash_697393.description: Rebbetzin Naama Perl tells Arutz Sheva's Dr. Chana Katan about her husband Rabbi Menachem Perl's psychological trauma following his work at Shura, her longing for the man he was and how she found a way to preserve her own strength.

flash_697391.description: In a new video, the Habayta Forum warns of a security threat in Judea and Samaria and urges scrapping the Oslo Accords and settling open land in Areas A and B to prevent another massacre. It calls on leaders to act before it is too late.

flash_697389.description: Lina Qassem (Zidan), about 60, killed by fragmentation grenade thrown by unidentified assailants at a business in Kafr Manda.

flash_697426.description: Jay Shapiro urges Netanyahu, Bennett, Eisenkot and Liberman to form a unity government, arguing that personal rivalries outweigh ideological differences.

flash_697425.description: SpaceX successfully catches its Starship spacecraft after 22 hours in orbit, marking a major breakthrough in reusable spaceflight despite a booster failure.

flash_697423.description: Samir Abu Yunis, the newly appointed commander of the Rafah Brigade in Hamas's military wing, was killed in four strikes targeting a refugee tent where he was staying west of Khan Yunis.

flash_697421.description: In Midrashic homilies, the pig came to represent Rome -- Esau's descendants. Can they ever fully repent?

flash_697419.description: More than 85,000 new homes remain unsold as sales slow, and the Housing Ministry’s director-general expects prices to fall further.

flash_697417.description: A British investigation reveals that Mayssoun Nassar, who has taken up a senior role at the BBC, described Israelis injured by rockets as "settlers" and Beersheba as an "occupied" city.

flash_697415.description: Iranian state television has warned that modified versions of the country's Khorramshahr ballistic missile could reach American military installations in Europe.

flash_697413.description: After a nationwide ground stop, Sean Duffy blames years of underinvestment, while Democrats question the administration’s response.

flash_697411.description: Kremlin says Donald Trump, Xi Jinping, and Vladimir Putin will hold talks on November 19 on the sidelines of the APEC summit.

flash_697408.description: Tasnim suggests Tehran could develop missile capable of reaching US, following directive attributed to Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei.

flash_697406.description: Twelve senators want to curb an expanding defense partnership. American troops and taxpayers could pay for their shortsightedness. Opinion.

flash_697402.description: MK Elisha Medan has announced plans to pitch a tent outside the Knesset and stay there until he succeeds in bringing about the formation of a broad-based government.

flash_697400.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu called on the leader of the Yashar! party to join him for closed-door talks, without preconditions, to reach agreements on forming a unity government.

flash_697398.description: Heavily pro-Israel Argentine President Javier Milei faces a sharp decline in public support, partly due to rising unemployment in his country.

flash_697437.description: Texas Governor-elect Gina Hinojosa says she will reverse the state's terrorist designation of CAIR, challenging a measure imposed by outgoing Governor Greg Abbott.

flash_697436.description:
The Brooklyn Nets and Israeli forward Danny Wolf suffered a 129-110 defeat to the Memphis Grizzlies in NBA action Saturday night. The loss dropped Brooklyn's record to three wins and nine losses.

Wolf finished the game with 14 points, six rebounds, and one assist.

flash_697434.description: Sen. John Fetterman warns he could leave the Democratic Party if Chris Van Hollen becomes Senate Majority Leader, citing his hostility toward Israel.

flash_697432.description: Temple Talk explores the Ethiopian Jewish holiday of Sigd, its connection to Jerusalem and hopes for rebuilding the Holy Temple, while welcoming the month of Kislev and revisiting Jacob and Esau’s struggle over the birthright.

flash_697430.description:
Hamas' military wing confirmed that Samir Abu Younis, the terrorist organization's Rafah Brigade commander, was eliminated overnight in a strike in the Al-Mawasi area of Khan Yunis, Reuters reported.

According to Hamas, Abu Younis was involved in planning the October 7 terrorist attack and overseeing its execution.

flash_697429.description: Yashar chairman Gadi Eisenkot plans to invite Likud into a unity government under his leadership, potentially offering Netanyahu a special diplomatic role. The Religious Zionist Party will also be approached.

flash_697427.description: An off-duty Border Police officer opens fire on a driver who endangered pedestrians and the officer himself in Acre. Driver seriously injured.

flash_697424.description:
Defense Minister Israel Katz commented on the elimination in Gaza in a post on social media, "The IDF continues to eliminate Hamas leaders in Gaza, and another one has joined his predecessors in the depths of hell."

"The offensive policy that I am leading together with the Prime Minister and the IDF in Gaza will continue until Gaza is demilitarized and Hamas is no more," he added.

flash_697422.description: You push through resistance, excuses, and business pressures to reach the wellspring. And you grab the lifeline and hold on with glee.

flash_697418.description: Today Jacob must increase his voice and must don the gloves of Esau to eliminate through absolute strength and deterrence every vestige of terror in its midst.

flash_697416.description: Two-year-old wanders off while his parents check in for a flight to Larnaca, is found unharmed on the conveyor belt.

flash_697414.description: India's counterterrorism unit arrests young man suspected of gathering information on Chabad House and Jewish institutions in Mumbai, passing it to parties outside the country.

flash_697412.description: Medline receives reports of 35 serious injuries as well as seven deaths associated with potential fire and entrapment hazards, issues updated guidance for customers.

flash_697467.description: Traffic police stop a woman caught praying from a book with both hands off the wheel, warning her of the danger as part of a road safety operation.

flash_697466.description: According to a Haskupim X post, a taxi operated by a leading company serving the Haredi community struck two Hasidic children on Friday evening.

flash_697464.description: In an interview with Arutz Sheva, Elisha Medan responds to claims that he is Netanyahu's political tool and acknowledges the distrust between the camps, saying, 'I personally am prepared to do anything.'

flash_697462.description: Developed from pioneering research led by Clalit Health Services - Beilinson Hospital, ALZAI Health and Ariel University, the new AI model is marking a major step toward earlier Alzheimer’s risk detection

flash_697460.description: Ariel Eliyahu's son was named Yedidya Lev after the newborn's uncle, Yedidya Eliyahu, who was killed in battle, during a circumcision ceremony at the hesder yeshiva in Safed.

flash_697458.description: New York-based haredi entrepreneur Ezra Ungar has made a rival bid for control of Arkia, including a $30 million injection, employee board representation and protection from layoffs. His main condition: ending Shabbat flights.

flash_697456.description: 'We are going to turn Texas red again,' Sen. Ted Cruz predicts multiple Trump impeachments, vows to reclaim Texas for Republicans, and leaves open a 2028 presidential bid.

flash_697454.description: A Russian investigation has revealed another grandson of Vladimir Putin, whose father shares the Ukrainian president's surname. The birth registration raised questions.

flash_697452.description: Religious Zionism's faction chairman joined the unity tent at the Knesset and called on Netanyahu and Eisenkot to begin negotiations, "Unity will come at a price and require compromises".

flash_697450.description: Prosecutors are considering indicting Petah Tikva Mayor Rami Greenberg on suspicion of receiving more than NIS 1 million in bribes, pending a hearing.

flash_697448.description:
Jerusalem Border Police officers discovered eight individuals illegally entering Israel who were hiding inside a large fuel tank loaded onto a pickup truck at the Tunnels Checkpoint over the weekend.

The officers stopped the vehicle for inspection after it aroused their suspicion. During the search, they discovered the eight individuals concealed inside the tank, allegedly attempting to enter Israel illegally.

The eight suspects and the vehicle's driver, a resident of eastern Jerusalem, were arrested and taken for questioning at the Jerusalem District Police's Moriah station.

The driver was brought before a court, which extended his detention until Monday (November 16).

flash_697447.description:
Bahrain officially confirmed that Iran launched an attack on its territory last night. According to a statement by Bahraini authorities, the aerial targets that penetrated its territory were intercepted and destroyed.

The Iranian Revolutionary Guards claimed to have launched six drones at an American radar in Bahrain. This is Iran's second attack on Bahraini territory in recent days, after a lull of several months in Iranian attacks against the Gulf states.

flash_697446.description:
The Speaker of the Iranian Parliament, Mohammad Bagher Qalibaf, commented on the unveiling of Iran's new missile city and emphasized its strategic significance.

According to him, "This important achievement goes beyond a mere technical and security matter; it is a symbol of a change in the strategic equations in the region."

flash_697444.description: A northern Israel resident allegedly contacted Iranian intelligence operatives on his own initiative, offering to carry out espionage missions for ideological reasons and a desire for revenge.

flash_697442.description: The greatest danger of rising antisemitism is how easily yesterday's outrage becomes tomorrow's normal.

flash_697440.description: The IDF and Shin Bet eliminated Samir Abu Younis, who replaced the brigade's previous commander following his elimination in September.

flash_697438.description:
The Iranian Revolutionary Guards announced that they used six drones to attack a radar of an American air defense system at the Al-Rifa'a helicopter base in Bahrain.

According to the organization, the attack was carried out in response to "hostile" actions by the United States.

flash_697497.description: Channel 12 reports suspected involvement by Netanyahu associates in the election-day arrests of Ra'am activists, based on intelligence later disputed.

flash_697496.description:
The Prime Minister’s Office rejected allegations in the Channel 12 report that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's associates supplied information that led to the arrest of Ra’am activists, calling it a “false report" intended, it claimed, to suppress the election interference affair.

“Another false report packaged with dramatic music, as part of the serious attempts to silence the election interference affair. As for the facts: Information concerning criminal activity reached chief of staff Ido Norden. He fulfilled his duty, as expected of any law-abiding citizen, and put the individual in contact with the police. Any additional involvement by the chief of staff alleged in the report is false and constitutes grounds for a defamation lawsuit. He never spoke with police intelligence officials or other officials involved in the investigation. As Israeli citizens and the chief of staff learned through the media on election morning, a person was indeed caught with tens of thousands of shekels in cash and Ra’am ballot slips," Netanyahu’s office stated.

flash_697495.description:
Days after resigning, Nvidia’s co-founder is discussing a potential comeback with allies as prominent investors push the board to consider his return.

Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang is considering returning as the company’s chief executive just days after his resignation, the Financial Times reported Sunday.

According to the report, Huang has discussed a potential comeback with allies in Silicon Valley who are seeking to persuade Nvidia’s board to reinstate him and secure support from the White House.

Nvidia shareholders Brad Gerstner, founder of Altimeter Capital, and Gavin Baker, head of Atreides Management, have urged the board to take a measured approach to choosing the company’s next leader and keep Huang’s potential return among its options.

Elon Musk has also backed calls for Huang’s reinstatement. Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress is currently serving as interim CEO.

flash_697493.description: Mandy Damari plans to return to Kibbutz Kfar Aza in 2027, determined to reclaim her home after the October 7 massacre and her daughter's captivity.

flash_697491.description: Israel's National Cyber Directorate said an examination of a malicious app impersonating Yad2 found that it gains access to contacts, the camera and additional device permissions.

flash_697489.description: Israeli war hero Ari Spitz visited the unity tent set up by MK Elisha Medan and called on leaders to overcome their differences and form a broad national government.

flash_697487.description: Three men convicted over the October shooting that killed nine mourners at a church in southern Jordan receive death sentences, subject to appeal.

flash_697485.description: The Philistines are still filling the wells. And Isaac’s children are still digging, in Rehovot, in Beersheba and across the Negev. The water is still rising. And the laughter has returned to the hills of Judea.

flash_697483.description: Bahrain intercepts Iranian drones targeting a US radar facility as Saudi Arabia downs Houthi drones and Tehran threatens further escalation in Hormuz.

flash_697481.description: Our working assumption must be that, as long as the ayatollahs’ regime in Tehran remains in power, Hezbollah will continue rebuilding its military capabilities while maintaining its civilian campaigns designed to preserve the support of its Shi'ite base. Analysis.

flash_697479.description: Political scientist Avi Diskin examines Eisenkot's coalition options, warning that most would produce unstable governments while unity offers an alternative.

flash_697477.description: Otzma Yehudit director-general Itiel Neiman is questioned over an alleged assault on police officers, as his party accuses authorities of political persecution.

flash_697475.description: The meeting between representatives of Likud and Yashar has concluded. A representative of the Together party also joined the discussions during the meeting.

flash_697473.description: UN ambassadors tour Kibbutz Kfar Aza and a Hamas terror tunnel, as Israeli officials warn that Gaza cannot be rebuilt while Hamas remains in control.

flash_697471.description:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu visited the Unity Tent MK Elisha Medan set up outside the Knesset in Jerusalem on Sunday.

During the visit, Medan told Netanyahu about his decision to erect the tent, the many visitors who came from across the country and from across the political spectrum, and the meetings that had taken place there.

Netanyahu expressed his support for Medan and praised him for his initiative and efforts to promote unity among the Israeli people. The two agreed that unity is an urgent necessity and pledged to work together in every possible way to achieve it.

flash_697470.description: Dani Elgarat accuses Likud MK Elisha Medan, who lost both legs fighting in Gaza, of hypocrisy over his plan to establish a unity tent near the Knesset.

flash_697469.description: The IDF confirms an Israeli civilian crossed into Jordanian waters and was detained, as authorities work to secure his return following the incident.

flash_697507.description: Days after resigning following controversy, Jensen Huang is considering returning to lead the chip giant. Senior Silicon Valley figures are working to rally support for his reinstatement.

flash_697506.description:
A resident of Zemer, in the Sharon region, was pronounced dead after being critically wounded by police gunfire when he allegedly pulled a knife on officers who arrived at his home.

Police were called to the scene following a report of a man behaving violently inside his home. According to initial reports, the man pulled a knife on the officers, who opened fire after feeling threatened. Emergency responders attempted to resuscitate him but were ultimately forced to pronounce him dead.

The man is believed to have suffered from a mental illness.

flash_697504.description: Walter Bingham, a Holocaust survivor from Jerusalem who will soon turn 103, skydives to raise funds for lone soldiers serving in the IDF.

flash_697502.description: UTJ chairman Yaakov Asher denies reports of progress in talks with Eisenkot, while Shas leader Aryeh Deri rejects negotiations and warns over conscription.

flash_697500.description: An extra NIS 10.5 million is sought for Science Minister Gila Gamliel's security amid increased threats, after protection was already stepped up. Iranian actors are believed to be targeting her over her ties to Iran's crown prince.

flash_697498.description: President hosts delegation led by Ambassador Danon, discusses Iranian threat and calls Hamas disarmament the key test for Gaza’s future.

flash_697494.description:
Yashar party chairman MK Gadi Eisenkot sharply criticized Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, claiming that his conduct and that of his associates pose “a tangible, direct and immediate threat to Israeli democracy."

Following an investigative report by Channel 12, Eisenkot said, “Netanyahu must not be allowed to continue serving as prime minister, nor should Israel be dragged into another election while he remains in office."

He called for an immediate investigation and clarification from the police and the Shin Bet, and announced that he would work to establish a commission of inquiry into the involvement of the Prime Minister’s Office and the conduct of the security agencies ahead of and during election day.

Read more.

flash_697492.description:
Israeli airline Arkia announced that it will cancel its flights to Phuket, Thailand, starting in January 2027.

According to the airline, the decision follows directives issued by Israeli security authorities prohibiting Israeli airlines from operating flights to the destination using leased aircraft from that date.

The company said passengers who have already booked tickets will be contacted individually and informed of the available solutions and alternatives. The restrictions apply only to flights to Phuket.

flash_697490.description: Channel 12 reports suspected involvement by Netanyahu associates in the election-day arrests of Ra'am activists, based on intelligence later disputed.

flash_697486.description: Minister Orit Strock urges sincere unity government talks and says she is willing to compromise, but warns that some agreements could cross her red lines.

flash_697484.description:
The US aircraft carrier Roosevelt is expected to enter the Middle East tomorrow and join two other aircraft carriers currently operating under US Central Command (CENTCOM).

According to the report, this will mark the first time that three US aircraft carriers have been deployed simultaneously in the Middle East.

flash_697482.description:
The USS Theodore Roosevelt is reportedly expected to enter the Middle East tomorrow, bringing the number of aircraft carriers under US Central Command (CENTCOM) to three.

According to the report, this would mark the first time three US aircraft carriers have been deployed simultaneously in the region.

flash_697478.description: When focus shifts entirely from our own experience to God’s presence and glory.

flash_697518.description: Former German Chancellor Angela Merkel says Hamas's use of civilians as human shields complicates Israel's security decisions and criticizes the scrutiny of Israel.

flash_697517.description: Brig. Gen. (res.) Amir Avivi calls on Netanyahu and Eisenkot to form a Zionist unity government, telling Arutz Sheva-Israel National News that both sides will have to make difficult compromises.

flash_697515.description: Federal investigators identify a tanker steering malfunction behind the New Orleans riverboat collision as crews examine recordings and prepare a lengthy salvage operation.

flash_697513.description: Milwaukee Bucks star Kyle Kuzma discusses his public support for Israel, his conversations with Deni Avdija and his hopes of visiting Jerusalem.

flash_697511.description: Jay Shapiro examines Stephen Miller’s reported elevation to White House chief of staff, and mounting concerns over US-Israel relations following the American midterm elections.

flash_697510.description:
The Iranian Navy announced that an oil tanker struck a mine and caught fire east of the Strait of Hormuz.

In a statement, the Navy said: "The tanker was sailing in a restricted area east of the Strait of Hormuz with its navigation systems turned off. The consequence of any unauthorized passage, conducted without coordination with the forces and in violation of regulations, is striking a mine and catching fire."

flash_697508.description:
The Otzma Yehudit party criticized MK Gadi Eisenkot over his remarks against Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu following an investigative report aired on the television program Uvda, accusing him of seeking to form a government with individuals the party describes as Hamas supporters.

In its statement, the party claimed that Eisenkot's opposition to critical security operations was "advancing a political payoff to Tibi and Abbas."

The statement added: "No media stunt will legitimize the fraudulent supporters of terrorism or the government Eisenkot wants to form with them."

flash_697505.description: The Prime Minister's haredi grandson, the son of Noa and Daniel Roth, marries in a small family ceremony in Jerusalem.

flash_697501.description: Houthis claim drone strike on gas pipeline near Riyadh

flash_697499.description: Bennett reportedly urges bloc partners to explore a unity government with Netanyahu, with Eisenkot serving first as prime minister, amid ongoing talks.
